name: ageannomo

relevance.justification: Covers core BioThings entity types (gene, protein, metabolite/chemical) plus mitochondrial genes, microbiota, and TCR/BCR sequences, annotated with aging-hallmark relations across 50 species; identifiers include gene symbols, UniProt entries, PubChem CIDs, and PubMed provenance, though multi-species gene symbols (vs. Entrez/Ensembl IDs) will require mapping work.

novelty.justification: No existing MyGene/MyChem/MyDisease/MyVariant source annotates genes, proteins, or metabolites for age-related differential expression, lifespan correlation, aging-related PPI/metabolite networks, or age-specific TCR/BCR repertoires; this is a distinct relation type (entity-to-aging-hallmark) absent from BioThings, confirmed against actual sampled fields (not just paper claims).

openness.justification: Data files (11 XLSX files across 8 aging-hallmark categories) are publicly downloadable with no login from the paper-designated GitHub companion repo (github.com/vikkihuangkexin/AgeAnnoMO) and mirrored on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8394076); license is CC BY-NC, which per project convention (Su Lab, academic/non-profit) is PASS but capped at 3/5 for the non-commercial restriction. The canonical web app (relab.xidian.edu.cn) is a JS-rendered Vue SPA whose Download tab could not be verified via HTTP fetch, so canonical-site access is unconfirmed and only the GitHub/Zenodo mirrors were verified directly.

evidence.scope: Multi-omics annotation of aging across genomic instability, epigenetic alterations, loss of proteostasis, mitochondrial dysfunction, intercellular communication, dysregulated metabolism, dysbiosis, aging-related immune repertoire, lifespan regulators, and anti-aging interventions (10 aging hallmarks). Paper (NAR 2024, D1) reports 90,972 aging-related genes, 16,244 proteins, 841 metabolites, 13 mitochondrial genes, 422 microbiotas, 229,413 TCR and 1,391 BCR sequences across 136 datasets, 50 species, 61 tissues, 8,596 samples, 1,044,141 cells. NOTE: the GitHub repo README states smaller counts (7,530 genes, 878 metabolites, 18 mitochondrial genes, 393 microbiotas, 138 datasets/48 species/8,525 samples/60 tissues) -- a version/staleness mismatch between the v1.0 GitHub release (Sept 2023) and the published NAR article (Jan 2024); flagged as risk.
evidence.overlap: Gene symbols and UniProt/PubChem identifiers overlap with entities already indexed in MyGene.info/MyChem.info, but the aging-hallmark annotation, differential-expression-by-age, and lifespan-correlation relations themselves are not present in any existing BioThings source.

risks: Canonical site (relab.xidian.edu.cn) is a JS-rendered Vue 3 SPA; its Download tab could not be confirmed via direct HTTP fetch -- verified access is through the GitHub/Zenodo mirrors named in the paper's Data Availability statement, not the live site itself

Entity counts differ between the published paper (90,972 genes/16,244 proteins/841 metabolites) and the GitHub v1.0 README (7,530 genes/878 metabolites) -- likely a stale repo snapshot vs. the live/published version
No single stable primary-key field across files; identifiers are gene symbols (species-specific, not Entrez/Ensembl) in most files, which requires species-aware ID mapping before BioThings ingestion
CC BY-NC license restricts commercial reuse; acceptable for Su Lab academic BioThings use per project convention but should be flagged to any commercial downstream consumers

Spans multiple BioThings entity types simultaneously (gene, protein, metabolite) rather than fitting cleanly into one existing API -- may require a new standalone API or multi-target annotation strategy
next_actions: Proceed to Phase 3 deep inspection / plugin generation
